rotational-euler-identity-299f94c5.interpretation: Rotational Euler Identity: The fundamental rule relating the angular acceleration and the product of angular velocities to the external torque along a principal axis.
rotational-euler-identity-299f94c5.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

dust-transparency-0c09539a.title: Dust Transparency
dust-transparency-0c09539a.interpretation: Dust Transparency: The ability of long-wavelength light to pass through cosmic gas clouds without being blocked.
dust-transparency-0c09539a.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

energy-split-98e2aa6f.title: Energy Split
energy-split-98e2aa6f.interpretation: Energy Split: The rule that separates external group motion from internal relative motion.
energy-split-98e2aa6f.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

total-radiation-bf891e8d.title: Total Radiation
total-radiation-bf891e8d.interpretation: Total Radiation: The master equation for all light emitted by matter near the speed of light.
total-radiation-bf891e8d.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

internal-consistency-54c78c4a.title: Internal consistency
internal-consistency-54c78c4a.interpretation: Internal consistency: Why the laws of light are only valid if charge never disappears.
internal-consistency-54c78c4a.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

the-s-integral-20595d65.title: The S-Integral
the-s-integral-20595d65.interpretation: The S-Integral: The calculation of the total "cost" of a physical process through the 4D whole.
the-s-integral-20595d65.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

curl-free-rule-9c2a2687.title: Curl-Free rule
curl-free-rule-9c2a2687.interpretation: Curl-Free rule: The rule that any field that is just a simple "slope" can never spin in circles.
curl-free-rule-9c2a2687.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

magnetic-dipole-9e8c1e09.title: Magnetic Dipole
magnetic-dipole-9e8c1e09.interpretation: Magnetic Dipole: The fundamental measure of a source's magnetic strength.
magnetic-dipole-9e8c1e09.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

semiclassical-wave-b139689d.title: Semiclassical Wave
semiclassical-wave-b139689d.interpretation: Semiclassical Wave: Shows how the wavefunction of a macroscopic system is dominated by the phase of the classical action.
semiclassical-wave-b139689d.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

field-strength-tensor-e9d1d77e.title: Field Strength Tensor
field-strength-tensor-e9d1d77e.interpretation: Field Strength Tensor: Generalizes the electromagnetic field tensor to include the self-interactions of non-Abelian gauge fields.
field-strength-tensor-e9d1d77e.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

grand-partition-function-a5c8de65.title: Grand Partition Function
grand-partition-function-a5c8de65.interpretation: Grand Partition Function: The master sum over all microstates for all possible particle numbers, weighted by energy and chemical potential.
grand-partition-function-a5c8de65.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

total-heat-flux-sum-27a8b7e6.title: Total Heat Flux Sum
total-heat-flux-sum-27a8b7e6.interpretation: Total Heat Flux Sum: The conservation principle stating that the observed stellar luminosity must be the sum of all internal transport channels.
total-heat-flux-sum-27a8b7e6.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

classical-limit-rule-3fefcb1b.title: Classical Limit Rule
classical-limit-rule-3fefcb1b.interpretation: Classical Limit Rule: The mathematical proof that the classical principle of least action emerges as the dominant structural feature in the limit of large action.
classical-limit-rule-3fefcb1b.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

rotational-energy-law-4b9ce40c.title: Rotational Energy Law
rotational-energy-law-4b9ce40c.interpretation: Rotational Energy Law: The mathematical proof that the energy transferred in a plane is identically determined by the integral of torque over the angular displacement.
rotational-energy-law-4b9ce40c.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

uniqueness-law-8b07eb8c.title: Uniqueness Law
uniqueness-law-8b07eb8c.interpretation: Uniqueness Law: The mathematical proof that specifying the potential on the boundary bits identically identifies the single physically valid field state.
uniqueness-law-8b07eb8c.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

standing-wave-boundary-condition-ac32c8a.title: Standing Wave Boundary Condition
standing-wave-boundary-condition-ac32c8a.interpretation: Defines the geometric constraint for a stable standing wave, requiring that an integer number of half-wavelengths fit perfectly within the confining potential width L.
standing-wave-boundary-condition-ac32c8a.symmetry_origin: The vanishing of the probability amplitude at the infinite potential barriers defining the system boundaries.
standing-wave-boundary-condition-ac32c8a.limits_and_boundary: The fundamental reason why confined quantum systems possess discrete energy spectra.

lorentz-tensor-transformation-2236e558.title: Lorentz Transformation of Tensors
lorentz-tensor-transformation-2236e558.interpretation: Defines the mathematical requirement for a physical quantity to be a rank-2 tensor, ensuring its components transform predictably between inertial frames.
lorentz-tensor-transformation-2236e558.symmetry_origin: The $SO(1,3)$ Lorentz symmetry of the background Minkowski manifold.
lorentz-tensor-transformation-2236e558.limits_and_boundary: The foundational operation for maintaining the frame-independence of physical laws in special relativity.

nomic-necessitation-relation-adt-ident-b.title: Nomic Necessitation (ADT)
nomic-necessitation-relation-adt-ident-b.interpretation: Describes the relation of necessitation N between universals F and G, which logically entails the universal regularity that all Fs are Gs.
nomic-necessitation-relation-adt-ident-b.symmetry_origin: The Armstrong-Dretske-Tooley (ADT) theory that laws are mind-independent facts about the world's structure.
nomic-necessitation-relation-adt-ident-b.limits_and_boundary: Explains why the regularity exists, rather than merely summarizing it, selectioning a governing role for the vacuum.

galactic-evolution-identity-3-d37f96d5.title: Eddington Luminosity Limit
galactic-evolution-identity-3-d37f96d5.interpretation: The maximum radiative luminosity a spherically symmetric accreting supermassive black hole can emit before the outward radiation pressure matches and overcomes the inward gravitational attraction.
galactic-evolution-identity-3-d37f96d5.symmetry_origin: Derived from the force balance between radiation pressure on free electrons (via Thomson scattering) and the gravitational pull on protons.
galactic-evolution-identity-3-d37f96d5.limits_and_boundary: Exceeded in super-Eddington accretion regimes where non-spherical geometries, high optical depths, or powerful relativistic winds permit enhanced mass inflow rates.

semantic_variables.M_{\\text{BH}}: Mass of the central supermassive black hole
semantic_variables.\\sigma_T: Thomson scattering cross-section of the electron
